data.name: Jawaanun
data.gender_notes: Jawaanun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawaanun is a name of Arabic origin which means 'young man, youth, jewel'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Jawwan', which means 'young man'. The addition of the suffix 'un' makes it a masculine name. The name Jawaanun carries the meaning “Youth, Jewel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jawaanun usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, jewel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jawaanun is a name with spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the importance of youth and the need to make the most of this precious time in life. It is also a symbol of the inherent value and worth of every individual, like a precious jewel.
data.etymology: Jawaanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, Jewel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawaanun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
